Path Array.js

Hello.

it's a polygon script to copy 1st child polygon object ( or folder contains several polygon objects ) along to 2nd spline object's path.

enjoy.

download -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=53

demo movie: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PwbkxBXRaes

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.
